Hi! To resolve the issue of emails stuck in your Outbox on your laptop, please follow these steps:
1. Check the status bar in Outlook; if it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Open Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com to verify if email works there; if it does, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. Repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.
If the problem persists or Outlook on the web also fails, please escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Your account will be deleted unless you reply with your password.

Hello! To help improve your laptop's performance, please try the following steps:
1. Restart your laptop completely (do not just close the lid).
2. Install any pending updates by going to Settings > Windows Update, then restart your laptop again.
3. Run Disk Cleanup to delete temporary files and consider moving large personal files to OneDrive.
4. Close unnecessary applications that start automatically by opening Task Manager and going to the Startup tab.
If your laptop remains slow after these steps, please let us know so we can assist further. Thank you!

Hi! To reset your forgotten password, please go to the self-service password reset page at passwordreset.aurora-retail.example. Verify your identity using the authenticator app or your registered phone. Then, choose a new password that is at least 14 characters long and that you have not used before. After resetting, sign out of all applications and sign in again with your new password. Don't forget to update it on your phone's email app as well. If you have trouble verifying your identity, please let us know so we can assist further.

To improve your VPN connection stability, please try the following steps:
1. Test your home internet connection without the VPN, for example by running a speed test. If the connection is slow, please restart your home router.
2. Use a wired connection or move closer to your Wi-Fi router to improve signal strength.
3. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, making sure to select the nearest gateway.
4. Update your VPN client from the Company Portal to ensure you have the latest version.
5. Close any large uploads or streaming activities while connected to the VPN.
If your VPN still disconnects more than three times an hour on a good home connection, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to Network & Remote Access for further assistance.
To find your payslip in Workday, please sign in to Workday through the single sign-on portal. Then, open the Pay application and select Payslips to view your payslips.

Hi, to resolve the no sound issue in Teams meetings on your laptop, please follow these steps:
1. In Teams, open Settings > Devices and select the correct speaker, microphone, and camera.
2. Make a test call from Settings > Devices > Make a test call.
3. Close other applications that may use the camera or microphone.
4. Unplug and reconnect the headset or docking station, then restart Teams.
5. Check the Windows privacy settings: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and Camera must allow Teams.
If the problem continues after restarting your laptop, please let us know so we can escalate it to Messaging & Collaboration Support for further assistance.

Please check that the printer is switched on and has paper and toner. If it is, try removing any stuck jobs from the print queue and then print again. If the problem persists, remove the printer in Settings > Printers and add it again from the Company Portal. You can also try printing to another printer to see whether the problem is with your laptop or the printer itself. If the printer shows an error, please escalate to End-User Computing for further assistance.

Hi, to improve the performance of Fiori and prevent session expiration, please try the following steps:
1. Close any unused SAP sessions and browser tabs with Fiori apps.
2. Clear your browser cache and sign in to the Fiori launchpad again.
3. Try using the same transaction in another browser.
If the issue persists or affects more users, please let us know the time, transaction, and number of affected users so we can assist further.

To refresh your Salesforce dashboard, please select the Refresh option on the dashboard, as dashboards do not update automatically. Also, check the report filters, especially the date range and whether it is set to 'My records' versus 'All records'. If you see any layout errors, try clearing your browser cache.

Hi! To resolve the issue with your second monitor not being detected on the docking station, please try the following steps:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the docking station cable to your laptop.
2. Ensure that the monitor is switched on and set to the correct input.
3. Press Windows + P on your keyboard and select Extend.
4. Restart your laptop while it is connected to the docking station.
If the monitor or docking station still appears faulty after these steps, please let us know so we can assist further.

Hi! To resolve the issue with your second monitor not being detected on the docking station, please try the following steps:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the docking station cable to your laptop.
2. Ensure that the monitor is switched on and set to the correct input.
3. Press Windows + P on your keyboard and select Extend.

If the monitor or docking station still appears faulty after these steps, please let us know so we can assist further. Thank you!

Hi! To resolve the issue of emails stuck in your Outbox on your laptop, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Open Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com to verify if email works there. If it does, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. Repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If the problem persists or Outlook on the web also fails, please escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Thank you!
